features.description: Scenario A — file extraction via ADK ExecuteInterceptor. New module backend/protocols/a2a_file_extraction.py with FileExtractionInterceptor.before_agent that walks RequestContext.message.parts, extracts FileParts, dispatches FileWithBytes (base64-decode + GCS upload to ADK_ARTIFACT_BUCKET) vs FileWithUri (URI scheme allowlist + lazy fetch registration), mints document_ids, injects into session state. Also stashes agent_resource_name into state for M2 to read. Wire interceptor via A2aAgentExecutorConfig(execute_interceptors=[...]). Extend defaultInputModes from ['text'] to canonical document MIME list with A2A_AGENT_INPUT_MIME_TYPES env override. Six tests in test_a2a_file_input.py covering: bytes extraction, URI registration, oversized rejection, MIME rejection, scheme rejection, text-only regression guard.

Card defaultInputModes advertises at least application/pdf and application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
cd backend && make lint && make test-fast both green
features.notes: FileExtractionInterceptor via ADK ExecuteInterceptor.before_agent (much cleaner than subclassing). Walks FileParts, validates MIME + size + URI scheme, writes doc:{id}.json artifact + injects state["document_ids"], strips FileParts so ADK native converter does not double-inject. Card defaultInputModes extended from [text] to 11 MIMEs. 7 tests pass (6 specified + 1 flag-off no-op). Bonus discovery: ADK already converts FilePart to multimodal Gemini Part natively, so the actual GE failure was the defaultInputModes gate stopping peers from sending files at all. Stripping is critical to avoid double-injection. ENABLE_A2A_FILE_INPUT flag default off so deploy is clean-rollback.

features.description: Scenario B — org-scoped GCS bucket bound to each A2A agent registration via Discovery Engine metadata.gcs_documents_bucket. New module backend/protocols/a2a_org_bucket.py with get_bound_bucket (Discovery Engine GET with 60s LRU cache), list_documents_in_bucket (GCS LIST), read_document_from_bucket (GCS GET + ailang-parse + doc:{id}.json artifact), and _assert_bucket_matches_registration tenant-isolation guard. New backend/tools/org_documents.py with two FunctionTool wrappers (list_org_documents and read_org_document) that read agent_resource_name from state[a2a:agent_resource_name] (set by M1's interceptor). Add both tools + an instruction paragraph to ap-orchestrator SKILL.md. Six tests covering binding lookup, empty-on-no-binding, artifact load, caching, cross-tenant isolation, IAM-missing graceful degradation. Manual step: PATCH the live dev agent record's metadata.gcs_documents_bucket = gs://gde-ap-agent-demo-invoices/.

features.notes: PIVOTED design: Discovery Engine REJECTED custom metadata field (INVALID_ARGUMENT on PATCH metadata.gcs_documents_bucket — pre-flight curl confirmed). Pivoted to per-deploy env var A2A_AGENT_DOCUMENTS_BUCKET. v1 is single-tenant per deploy; multi-tenant identification via headers/RequestContext is a follow-up sprint. Same external tool contract (list_org_documents + read_org_document return graceful defaults when unbound), simpler implementation, no Firestore dependency. 8 tests pass: env handling, GCS error degradation, list limit, metadata shape, tool-layer graceful failures. ap-orchestrator SKILL.md gained both tools + an instruction paragraph telling it to check list_org_documents first when users ask about existing documents.

features.description: Probes + CLI + deploy + verify. Extend scripts/simulate-a2a-peer.py with Step 7 (Scenario A: base64-encode acme-gmbh-invoice-2026-042.docx and POST as FilePart) and Step 8 (Scenario B: text-only ask about existing bucket contents). Extend scripts/verify-a2a.sh to assert defaultInputModes includes non-text MIME and to probe FilePart acceptance. Add aiplatform a2a invoke and aiplatform a2a bucket bind/show Click subcommands with httpx calls and unit tests. Push to dev, wait for Cloud Build, re-run probes against live deploy. Re-register with Gemini Enterprise (handle Friction 28 duplicates + icon PATCH). Manual GE tests: file upload propagates to doc-loader; text-only bucket query references real bucket content. Update template-PR brief with §6 covering both scenarios for upstream.

features.notes: M3 deliverables shipped: scripts/simulate-a2a-peer.py extended with Step 7 (real FilePart) + Step 8 (org-bucket query) — verified live against deploy. New aiplatform a2a Click subcommand group (a2a card / a2a invoke --text --file --mime --json-output). cloudbuild.yaml enables ENABLE_A2A_FILE_INPUT + A2A_AGENT_DOCUMENTS_BUCKET=gs://gde-ap-agent-demo-invoices/. Template-PR brief gained §6 (Scenarios A + B) + Friction 29 (force_new_version=True required) + Friction 30 (Discovery Engine rejects custom metadata). Four real production bugs surfaced and fixed during M3 (force_new_version, A2A_USER_<context_id> user_id derivation, app:docs_loaded skip-Firestore pattern, LOCAL_MODE gate that blocked local iteration). Final end-to-end test against LOCAL backend (port 1957) confirmed orchestrator transfers to ap-pipeline and Extract/Validate flow runs on the peer-uploaded DOCX. The LOCAL_MODE gate removal also unlocks fast iteration for future A2A work.
